DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception

The clinical picture of an 8-month-old male with feverless abdominal distension, feeding difficulties, and crying that worsens on palpation is highly suggestive of intussusception, even in the absence of classic "currant jelly" stools or vomiting.
